Class SmartMotorControllerTelemetry

java.lang.Object
yams.core.telemetry.SmartMotorControllerTelemetry
public class SmartMotorControllerTelemetry extends Object
Smart motor controller telemetry.

Publishes motor controller state including duty-cycle output voltage, stator/supply current, rotor/mechanism position and velocity, and motor temperature to NetworkTables so that tools such as SmartDashboard, Elastic, and Advantage Scope can consume the data in real time. Tunable fields (PID gains, setpoints, motion-profile limits) are additionally exposed on a separate Tuning table so they can be adjusted without redeploying code.

This class is managed internally by SmartMotorController. You do not normally instantiate it directly; instead call the methods on the motor controller itself:

Basic usage (default NetworkTable path)

// In robotInit() or subsystem constructor:
motor.setupTelemetry();   // publishes under Mechanisms/<motorName>

// In robotPeriodic() or subsystemPeriodic():
motor.updateTelemetry();

Custom NetworkTable path and telemetry config

NetworkTable dataTable   =
NetworkTableInstance.getDefault().getTable("Mechanisms").getSubTable("Shooter"); NetworkTable
tuningTable = NetworkTableInstance.getDefault().getTable("Tuning").getSubTable("Shooter");

motor.setupTelemetry(dataTable, tuningTable);

// In periodic:
motor.updateTelemetry();

    • applyTuningValues

      public void applyTuningValues(SmartMotorController smartMotorController)
      Apply the tuning values from NetworkTable to the SmartMotorController
      Parameters:
      smartMotorController - SmartMotorController to control.
      Throws:
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if the controller's control mode is not CLOSED_LOOP.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if the underlying motor controller implementation rejects a tuned gain (for example, a gain applied while slot 3 is active on a TalonFX).
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if the underlying motor controller implementation rejects an unsupported vendor control request when applying a setpoint or slot.
      IllegalArgumentException - if the tuned closed loop controller slot is not supported by the underlying motor controller implementation (for example, slot 3 on a TalonFX or TalonFXS).
